Source: average Kendall rank correlation between node rankings of 349 measures over 648 ICON networks (Centrality Zoo, Shvydun 2025). cograph implements 101 distinct measures covering 102 of those labels, 38 of them added in batches 7 to 9. Colour: white = 0, blue = 1 for correlations; red to blue through white for differences. Every figure is followed by the numbers, so nothing is encoded by colour alone.

Our measurements against the Zoo

The same 97 measures computed on 19 real undirected networks (10 to 81 nodes: karate, kite, UKfaculty, macaque, 12 food webs, les_miserables, florentine, davis), pairwise Kendall tau averaged over networks, then compared pair by pair.

Statistic over the 4654 measure pairs Value
Correlation between the two matrices 0.69
Mean absolute difference 0.14
Median absolute difference 0.09
Pairs agreeing within 0.20 78%

Five measures carry most of the disagreement: constraint, clusterrank, dmnc, local_dimension and flow_coefficient. Dropping them lifts the correlation to 0.78 over the remaining 4185 pairs. The first three match their reference implementations exactly, so the gap is about the Zoo’s conventions rather than cograph’s arithmetic.

Where the two disagree most

flow_coefficient against transitivity is the clearest case: the Zoo prints an unbounded formula that differs from the paper’s, while ours equals one minus the clustering coefficient on an undirected graph, so the two matrices report 0.02 and 1.00 for the same pair. constraint is negatively oriented, so its agreement depends on a sign convention the Zoo does not state, and dmnc differs because centiserve::dmnc() counts a component’s edges in the wrong index space.

An earlier run of this report put katz among the worst rows. That turned out to be cograph’s own defect rather than a convention difference: Katz converges only for an attenuation below one over the spectral radius, and the 0.1 default is invalid on several of these food webs. This run uses a valid attenuation per network, and katz moved from a profile correlation of 0.56 to 0.76. centrality() now warns when the attenuation cannot converge.

Full coverage document

What the Centrality Zoo comparison (Shvydun 2025, Zoo of Centralities, arXiv:2511.05122) says about cograph’s centrality() surface. Generated by docs/zoo/zoo_coverage.py from the site’s correlation.json (gzipped copy in docs/zoo/). Regenerate after adding measures; edit the COVERED map in the script, not this file.

Source

  • Matrix of average Kendall rank correlation between node rankings, 349 measures, computed on 648 empirical networks from the Index of Complex Networks (ICON). The encyclopedia assumes undirected, unweighted, loop-free graphs, so redundancy on a directed weighted transition matrix may differ.
  • Off-diagonal tau: min 0.00, median 0.67, mean 0.63, max 1.00.
  • The Zoo’s own code is unreleased (its Code page says so), so nothing here is validated against Zoo output. cograph validates each measure against reference packages, published worked examples, or brute-force igraph.

Backlog

Batch 7 (2026-09-06) shipped distance entropy, local dimension, local information dimensionality, modularity vitality and neighborhood connectivity; batch 8 (same day) shipped every remaining item of the ranked list: the three Shapley games, access and hide information, rumor centrality, community hub-bridge, entropy variation (degree and betweenness), the s-shell index, DegreeDiscountIC, SingleDiscount and NCVoteRank. Batch 9 (same day) shipped twenty more: the community trio (CbC, Comm, CbM), three dimension measures, WVoteRank, EnRenew, VoteRank++, node contraction (plain and improved), two-way random-walk betweenness, heatmap, flow coefficient, local entropy, weighted h-index, redundancy, weighted k-shell, renewed coreness and geodesic k-path. Nothing is queued.

Deliberately skipped:

  • Hybrid (Pozzi): tau 0.00 with all 348 partners: looks like a broken run, not a measure
  • Physarum / K-shell Physarum centrality: iterative flow solver, heavy
  • Absorbing Random-Walk (ARW): set-function greedy, heavy
  • LRIC family, SRIC, Interdependence: author’s own long-range-influence measures; no closed form
  • Node information dimension (NID): box scheme in the encyclopedia is ambiguous; original paper paywalled
  • Game centrality (GC), Algebraic centrality, Community centrality: definition not pinned
  • DegreePunishment: source article (Wang, Su, Zhao & Yi 2016) unobtainable; Zoo entry alone leaves beta_c and the seed rule open
  • Improved WVoteRank: source article (Kumar & Panda 2022) unobtainable; Zoo formula has three unresolved switches
  • Local degree dimension (LDD): source article (Zhong, Zhang & Deng 2022) unobtainable; the Zoo formula’s bracketing is ambiguous
  • Multi-local dimension (MLD): for every q outside (0, 1) it is q/(q-1) times local_dimension, reversed inside (0, 1), and q = 1 is local_information_dimension over the full range; nothing new to rank
